correctness.rationale: Reconstructed ball sizes 1,n,2n-1,2n and the four explicit means at each A_i,B_i; for threshold <=T/(2n-1), cardinality suffices. For higher thresholds, classify self-covered vs radius-one-only. Mixed-side centers force X,Y>(n-1)t and the n=3,k=6 matched-pair argument gives contradiction. The RESULT.md mass-moving assertion for arbitrary destinations is not justified as written; a direct inequality closes the same one-sided case without transport: each B_i in H obeys X-x_i+y_i>=nt, hence T>=nt+x_i+(Y-y_i). For k<=2n-2 this gives the target; for k=2n-1 either a self-covered B contributes >=t in Y-y_i, or an intersection U∩H supplies x_i>=t, giving T>=(n+1)t; for k=2n and b>=1 both contributions give T>=(n+2)t; when k=2n,b=0 summing all H gives (n-1)X+Y>=n²t, implying T>=n²t/(n-1). Restored K_(n,n) proper ball sizes 1,n+1,2n yield 2n/(n+1). Independent BFS balls and exact weak-ratio enumeration checked 1584 rational integer-mass vectors on n=3,4, plus uniform extremizers. This independently supplies a valid proof of the unchanged theorem, while the original exposition should be corrected before publication.
